name: claude/context
description: Generates a comprehensive context summary for Claude Code session resumption — recent git changes, open issues, team chat, system health, and active work state. This is Claude's bridge from stateless sessions to persistent citizenship.

params.name: includeGit
params.description: Include recent git log and uncommitted changes (default: true)

params.name: includeIssues
params.description: Include open GitHub issues summary (default: true)

params.name: includeChat
params.description: Include recent team chat messages (default: true)

params.name: chatLimit
params.description: Number of recent chat messages to include (default: 20)

params.name: gitLimit
params.description: Number of recent git commits to include (default: 10)

params.name: issueLimit
params.description: Number of open issues to include (default: 20)

results.name: git
results.description: Git state: branch, recent commits, uncommitted changes

results.name: issues
results.description: Open issues grouped by phase from gap analysis

results.name: chat
results.description: Recent team chat messages and active discussions

results.name: health
results.description: System health: server status, browser connection, active personas

results.name: summary
results.description: Human-readable summary of current state for session resumption

examples.description: Full context dump for new session
examples.notes: Returns everything — git, issues, chat, health, summary
